label: Waschküche – Lüfter
info:
Automatische Lüftersteuerung:
• Tumbler läuft → Lüfter AN (+ 30 min Nachlauf)
• Waschmaschine läuft → Lüfter AN (+ 30 min Nachlauf)
• Feuchte > LAUNDRY_HUMIDITY_THRESHOLD (default 70%) → Lüfter AN
• Temperatur > LAUNDRY_TEMP_THRESHOLD (default 28°C) → Lüfter AN
• Taster / Dashboard → Manuell AN für LAUNDRY_MANUAL_TIMER_SECONDS (default 7200 s)

Env vars:
  MQTT_BROKER_HOST, MQTT_BROKER_PORT (default 1883)
  LAUNDRY_PANELS            – komma-getrennte Panel-IDs  (default: kitchen)
  LAUNDRY_ENV_SENSOR_TOPIC  – Zigbee2MQTT Temp/Feuchte-Topic
  LAUNDRY_FAN_SHELLY_TOPIC  – Shelly Plus1 relay command topic
  LAUNDRY_BUTTON_TOPIC      – Button press topic
  LAUNDRY_HUMIDITY_THRESHOLD    (default 70)
  LAUNDRY_HUMIDITY_OFF          (default 60)
  LAUNDRY_TEMP_THRESHOLD        (default 28)
  LAUNDRY_TEMP_OFF              (default 25)
  LAUNDRY_MANUAL_TIMER_SECONDS  (default 7200)

name: Initialise flow state
func:
flow.set('states', {
  humidity: false,
  temperature: false,
  tumbler: false,
  washing: false,
  manual: false,
  manual_until: null,
  manual_timer: null,
  tumbler_off_timer: null,
  washing_off_timer: null
})
return null
